long_biography.plain_text:
Gert Verhulst helped conceive 40-45, a Studio 100 musical about two brothers divided by the Second World War. Working on the concept with director and scriptwriter Frank Van Laecke, he championed a production in which the audience itself moved. Mobile seating carried spectators through the performance, while headphones delivered the music, voices and sound effects.

Television offered a different creative challenge: adapting stories for different audiences. Studio 100 developed the teenage mystery Het Huis Anubis for Nickelodeon and made a separately cast version for Germany. An English-language production for the British and American markets was filmed in Liverpool.
